result.title: A Cue's Hidden Price: Auditing Seller Influence on AI Shoppers
result.summary: Large language models are increasingly asked to shop on a user's behalf, which lets seller-controlled content such as badges, endorsements, and framing steer what they recommend. That poses the question at the core of generative engine optimization (GEO): not whether seller content shifts an agent's choice, but how much. The usual gauge of that influence, how often a cue wins the choice, has a blind spot: once a cue is strong enough to be picked almost every time, the choice rate can no longer show how much stronger one cue is than another. We introduce price-equivalent (PE) auditing, which removes this ceiling by pricing the cue in money. In a counterbalanced, position-controlled forced choice, we raise the cued product's price until it is chosen only half the time, and report that premium as the cue's price-equivalent: a formally defined, policy-conditioned parity threshold that makes very different cues comparable. Priced this way, cues that look equally strong at equal price differ by a wide margin, so choice-rate audits substantially under-resolve seller influence. We run the audit over 113,472 trials, seven models across families, and two product categories. To our knowledge, we also run the first price-equivalent audit of a decision-native model, Jev, which outputs a choice probability directly instead of generating text; strikingly, its profile is unlike any text model we tested, resisting most cues yet remaining susceptible to the strongest social-proof claims. We release the stimuli, logs, and code as a benchmark that reports each model's cue-price profile rather than a single score, giving developers and auditors a common, reproducible way to measure how content moves AI shopping agents.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「价格等价」（PE）审计：在配对、位置受控的强制选择中不断抬高被线索商品的价格，直到其被选中概率降到一半，以该溢价量化卖家线索对 LLM 购物代理决策的影响，并在 11 万余次试验、七个模型（含直接输出选择概率的决策型模型 Jev）与两个品类上给出各模型的线索-价格画像。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不涉及视觉或 latent 推理，但其「策略条件下的等价阈值」把受天花板限制的选择率换算成可比较的影响强度，可能为衡量视觉证据或 latent 内容对答案的实际因果贡献提供评价思路，可供核查。
